analysis:
Examined all five added files, patches, source replays and metadata under the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. No independently supported security regression in this scope. Paths below are under libs/darkbloom-cluster/Sources/DarkbloomClusterRuntime/Models/Gemma4/TensorParallel/.
Gemma4TensorParallelSelection.swift:46-164 exchanges logits, token IDs and flags through an external reduction; topK bounds local count/shape and checks MLX evaluation errors. Integration must verify peer authorization, confidentiality, collective shape/time bounds and handling of adversarial/nonfinite collective values before Float-to-Int conversion at line 116 (A-001, TB-007, T-007, T-056). The reduction implementation and callers are absent; that is not proof of missing controls.
Gemma4TensorParallelShareProbe.swift:30-78 uses synthetic tokens, admission/deadline checks, a local reduction scope, bounded rounds and retirement on success/error. Verify local-mode restoration, callback cancellation/deadline enforcement and native retirement in dependencies (T-010, A-018); its reported timing is not attested capacity (T-055).
Gemma4TensorParallelVerifiedLoad.swift:38-87 delegates artifact preparation, inventory conservation and memory gating, checks loaded tensor shape/type/bytes, and returns artifact/storage receipts. Integration must verify pinned-read integrity, shard materialization/accounting and comparison of both ranks' receipts before serving (A-004, T-012, T-027, T-053). These controls are external contracts, not established by comments.
Gemma4TensorParallelSplitSum.swift:24-170 installs local quantized projection oracles; plan validation supplies nonempty parts and valid shapes/quantization. Gemma4TensorParallelSynthetic.swift:25-102 bounds generation parameters and writes fixed checkpoint filenames to a caller-selected directory; no supplied evidence exposes this to consumers or substitutes it for verified production weights. No cache persistence/scope changes (T-041), direct authorization, encryption, credential or billing changes appear here. Remaining review concerns are cross-file contracts, not findings.
